title.ja: 図1-1 どうやって崩す？

explain.ja: 図1-1のような高美濃囲いを崩す順を考えます。全く手のついていない状態で、攻め駒は飛車しかなく王手もできませんが、どこから攻めればよいでしょうか。
explain.en: Consider how to break a Taka-Mino (high Mino) castle as in Diagram 1-1. It is completely untouched, the only attacker is the rook and no check is available; where should the attack start?

section.ja: 囲い崩しのコツは玉の近くの金を狙う
section.en: The key to breaking a castle is to target the gold near the king

title.ja: 図1-2 桂馬で金を狙う
title.en: Figure 1-2: Target the gold with the knight

explain.ja: 囲い崩しの大原則は、安い駒で玉の近くの金を狙うことです。今回は持ち駒の桂馬で▲7五桂と打ち、6三の金を狙います。囲い崩しで困ったときは、持ち駒の桂馬で金を狙う手が好手になりやすいです。
explain.en: The great principle of breaking a castle is to target the gold near the king with a cheap piece. Here, drop the knight in hand with ▲7五桂 to aim at the gold on 6三. When stuck breaking a castle, targeting a gold with a knight in hand often works well.

section.ja: 囲い崩しのコツは玉の近くの金を狙う
section.en: The key to breaking a castle is to target the gold near the king

title.ja: 図1-3 香車でさらに金を狙う
title.en: Figure 1-3: Target the gold further with the lance

explain.ja: 図1-2から△6二金引とすれば、▲6三香と打ってさらに金を狙います。これを△同金と取れば、▲同桂成、△同銀、▲6一飛成で高美濃囲いは崩壊です。囲い崩しは桂馬や香車などの安い駒で玉の近くの金を狙うのが大原則で、有名な囲いには崩すための手筋が多く研究されています。
explain.en: From Diagram 1-2, if White retreats with △6二金引, drop ▲6三香 to keep aiming at the gold. If White takes with △同金, ▲同桂成 △同銀 ▲6一飛成 collapses the Taka-Mino. The basic principle of castle-breaking is to target the gold near the king with cheap pieces such as the knight and lance, and many tesuji have been studied for famous castles.

section.ja: 囲い崩しのコツは玉の近くの金を狙う
section.en: The key to breaking a castle is to target the gold near the king

title.ja: 図2-1 舟囲いを寄せる
title.en: Figure 2-1: Closing in on the Boat castle

explain.ja: 次は寄せの流れを見ます。例えば図2-1のように舟囲いを寄せていく順を考えます。
explain.en: Next, look at the flow of a finish. For example, consider how to finish a Funakakoi (Boat castle) as in Diagram 2-1.

section.ja: 寄せのコツは駒を安易に清算しないこと!
section.en: The key to the finish is not to trade pieces carelessly!

title.ja: 図2-2 まずは囲い崩しの原則
title.en: Figure 2-2: First, the principle of breaking castles

explain.ja: 図2-1から▲5三銀、△4二金と進みました。これは囲い崩しの原則に従って金を狙っています。後手は5三の銀を取ると飛車で玉を取られるので、やむなく△4二金と形を引き締めて粘っています。ここで本当にすぐ▲4二銀成としてよいか、考えてみましょう。
explain.en: From Diagram 2-1 the game went ▲5三銀 △4二金. This follows the castle-breaking principle by targeting the gold. If White took the silver on 5三, the rook would capture the king, so White reluctantly tightens the shape with △4二金. Consider whether ▲4二銀成 right away is really correct.

section.ja: 寄せのコツは駒を安易に清算しないこと!
section.en: The key to the finish is not to trade pieces carelessly!

title.ja: 図2-3 さらに攻め駒を足していく

explain.ja: 図2-2からはすぐに▲4二銀成と金を取らず、▲7五角として力を貯めます。相手玉を寄せるときは、攻め駒は持ち駒より盤上にある方が有効です。盤上の駒をすぐに清算しないのが寄せのコツです。後手はどのみち5三の銀を取れないので、攻めの態勢を整えてから▲4二銀成、△同銀、▲同角成と攻めればよいのです。
explain.en: From Diagram 2-2, do not capture the gold at once with ▲4二銀成; build strength with ▲7五角. When finishing against the king, attackers are more effective on the board than in hand. The knack of finishing is not to liquidate pieces on the board right away. White cannot take the silver on 5三 anyway, so after preparing the attack, proceed with ▲4二銀成 △同銀 ▲同角成.

section.ja: 寄せのコツは駒を安易に清算しないこと!
section.en: The key to the finish is not to trade pieces carelessly!

title.ja: 図3-1 どうやって攻める？

explain.ja: 図3-1は終盤に相手玉を追い詰めている局面です。今にも詰みそうですが、ここでどう指すのが良いでしょうか。
explain.en: Diagram 3-1 is an endgame where the enemy king is being cornered. Mate seems near, but how should you play?

section.ja: 詰みのコツは王手しないこと!?
section.en: Tip for checkmate: do not give check!?

title.ja: 図3-2 ▲2六銀でも△3六玉で逃げられる
title.en: Figure 3-2: Even ▲2六銀 lets the king escape with △3六玉

explain.ja: ▲3三銀と王手すると、△2五玉と逃げられて、これ以上攻められなくなります。さらに▲2六銀と王手しても△3六玉と逃げられます。
explain.en: If you check with ▲3三銀, the king escapes with △2五玉 and you cannot attack further. Even checking with ▲2六銀 allows △3六玉.

section.ja: 詰みのコツは王手しないこと!?
section.en: Tip for checkmate: do not give check!?

title.ja: 図3-3 次に▲2五銀と▲3三銀の詰み
title.en: Figure 3-3: Next ▲2五銀 and ▲3三銀 is checkmate

explain.ja: 図3-1からは▲2六銀が好手です。これは次の▲2五銀の詰みと▲3三銀の詰みの両方を狙っており、後手には適当な受けがなく必至です。詰みが見つからないときは、無理に王手するより詰めろで迫る方が好手になることが多いです。
explain.en: From Diagram 3-1, ▲2六銀 is the good move. It threatens mate by ▲2五銀 and mate by ▲3三銀, and White has no adequate defense, so it is a brinkmate. When you can't find a mate, approaching with a mate threat is often better than forcing a check. The endgame tips so far: aim at the gold near the king when breaking a castle, don't liquidate attackers immediately, and when no mate is visible attack with a mate threat instead of checking.

section.ja: 詰みのコツは王手しないこと!?
section.en: Tip for checkmate: do not give check!?
